replies.author: StewieFG
replies.body:
Since the screenshots weren't the best, I downloaded it and saw it. 
The map is pretty small.
In-case a nexus match with 10v10 will be, the map won't play good because it'll be too small.
Another problem in my opinion, is the side-caves, they are well detailed but too thin, nexus is Archery & Sword, and in the cave-sides and the middle you don't have enough space for PvP.
Overal the map is realyl good and detailed like I said before, I feel like I could really help you with that, you should contact me on skype. (ERIC_MCgamer is my skype).

replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
[Denied]
I'm sorry, but your map has been denied for the following reasons.
-Lack of effort: The map shows no noticeable effort. It is very flat in the surface, and shows to be very small in the interior. Not much pvp space has been provided.
-Lack of creativity: At the end of the day, it just seems like a ravine that converted into a Nexus map. It has not many defining features to make it stand out for this.

Feel free to make changes to the map in any foreseeable way that you believe would benefit your map's chances.
